# Relations

<!-- Generated from the feature manifests. Do not edit by hand:
     edit <feature>.manifest.ts, then run `npm run docs:reference`. -->

What `timer` needs on the page, what it is normally used with, and what breaks it.

## Dependencies

`timer` works on its own — nothing else has to be on the page.

## Conflicts

None known. Several instances of this feature can coexist on a page.

## Common combinations

- [`conditional-display`](../../../display/conditional-display/guide/overview.md) — a countdown usually needs the offer it gates to disappear with it, which is a condition rather than a timer concern.
